title: Extended Barrels
description: Extended barrels adds tiered barrel blocks that expand beyond vanilla barrels, offering larger inventories and a clean, vanilla-friendly design. Progress through multiple storage tiers to store more items
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc8610be0baff21da11eb644b0746c5a8fccb856.webp)
- ## New Blocks
  - Iron Barrel (36 slot)
  - Copper Barrel (45 slot)
  - Gold Barrel (55 slot)
  - Diamond Barrel (60 slot)
  - Emerald Barrel (65 slot)
  - Netherite Barrel (78 slot)
- ## Features:
  - A Smooth design vanilla-like for every barrel
  - Every barrel have his own slots
  - Crafting recipes is very easy
> Report a bug in [https://discord.gg/creativty-studio]([https://discord.gg/xnHwqszNUa](https://discord.gg/tmZc6bbgYB)) and we will reply as soon we can
